Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface TwoFactorAuthService

All Known Implementing Classes:
TwoFactorAuthServiceImpl
public interface TwoFactorAuthService
Service interface for Two-Factor Authentication operations. This interface defines the contract for TOTP setup, verification, backup codes, and 2FA management within the security framework of the application.

Key 2FA services include:

  • TOTP Setup: Generate secret keys and QR codes for authenticator apps
  • Code Verification: Validate TOTP codes and backup codes during login
  • Backup Code Management: Generate and regenerate backup codes for account recovery
  • 2FA State Management: Enable, disable, and check 2FA status for users
  • Security Controls: Replay attack prevention and time-based validation

This service integrates with the authentication system to provide an additional layer of security through time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) following RFC 6238 standards, ensuring compatibility with popular authenticator applications.
